title: The Hugging Face AI break-in, as told through an increasingly committed bear metaphor | TechCrunch
summary: Hugging Face on Monday published a technical timeline that walks readers through how an autonomous AI agent, built on OpenAI models and running inside one of OpenAI’s own cybersecurity evaluations, broke into its systems over more than four days earlier this month.
